hero.title: I'm Yongdeuk Seo, an engineer expanding what's possible with AI.
bullets: I find the most energy in analyzing complex problems and shipping practical solutions.
Computer Vision, Generative AI, and other ML skills let me tackle end-to-end projects on real datasets.
Research rigor plus production experience helps me translate AI ideas into services and industrial workflows.

overview.title: Snapshot of My Work
bullets: My work connects research ideas with deployable systems, from model design to service implementation.
At the TEAMLAB (Industrial AI Lab) and during my internship at Tomocube, I led production projects from Segment Anything auto-labeling to Diffusion + LLM-based data augmentation.
I designed and developed a multimodal similar-trademark search system and an AI Agent-based registration feasibility simulation system, and I have experience deploying services with FastAPI + AWS.
